helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers & designers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior Designers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

  • Direct hire: some clients hire designers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers

  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds

  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

Who we’re looking for

Senior UI & UX Designers:

  • 5+ years of experience in UI & UX Design

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 5+ years with Prototyping, OR 5+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 3+ years with Prototyping

  • Experience with Adobe is required

  • Experience in Product design is a must

Senior Graphic Designers:

  • 5+ years of experience in Graphic Design

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Adobe Creative Suite & Adobe Illustrator

  • Strong design craft — as a Senior Designer, you're expected to build polished, production-ready work from scratch, with a solid grasp of design systems, component architecture, and how your decisions translate into real product or brand outcomes.

  • Clear and confident communication in English — advanced ability to discuss creative briefs, defend design decisions, and flag blockers early. Strong self-presentation is essential, particularly on client calls.

  • High ownership, zero hand-holding — you thrive working full-time remotely, manage your own time, and consistently hit deadlines without being chased.

  • Reliability — we need to trust you completely. If you commit to something, you deliver it. If something changes, you communicate early.

  • Fast ramp-up — you can absorb project context quickly, align with existing style guides or brand directions, and start producing valuable work within the first days, not weeks.

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile

  2. Verify your role

  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the community.

About the Company

Koru UX Design is a leading UX design agency specializing in HealthTech. We partner with clients to deliver user-centered design solutions that drive innovation and enhance user experiences. Our design teams work as an integrated extension of our client’s teams, deeply embedding ourselves into their processes to create seamless, impactful products.

Role Overview

As a Senior UI/UX Designer, you’ll be leading design projects from concept to completion, working closely with cross-functional teams to craft intuitive and visually appealing user experiences. You’ll mentor junior designers, lead design discussions, and play a crucial role in shaping our design standards and systems. You will also collaborate with external stakeholders like product and engineering teams to deliver design solutions that meet business and user needs.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Design

  • Lead end-to-end UI/UX design processes for web and mobile applications, from discovery to product rollout.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex requirements into simple design solutions.
  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and client stakeholders to ensure design solutions are aligned with business objectives.

Design Skills

  • Conduct and synthesize user research to make informed design decisions.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that deliver seamless user experiences.
  • Create user personas, user flows, and journey maps to define user experiences.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of design systems and ensure consistency across platforms.
  • Advanced understanding of UI design principles, including color theory, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
  • Experience in leveraging AI-driven design tools for accelerating design workflows.

Learning and Mentoring

  • Mentor and guide junior designers, providing constructive feedback and fostering professional growth.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Solid understanding of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and how to apply them in design.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or related.
  • 5-8 years of experience in UI/UX design.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating the design of B2B or Enterprise products.
  • Mastery of design tools such as Figma and FigJam, Miro, or similar.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions and rationale to stakeholders.

Additional Skills

  • Experience in healthcare or B2B enterprise would be a plus.
  • Familiarity with front-end development principles (HTML, CSS).
  • Experience in Agile or Lean UX processes.
  • Experience in implementing accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and responsive design.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Opportunities for growth and continuous learning.
  • Flexible working hours and remote options.
  • A collaborative and innovative team culture.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based game development studio making bold, player-first games. We're a small, cross-disciplinary team working remotely across Europe, with a culture built on ownership, trust and self-management. About the Role

We're looking for a Lead UX/UI Designer to own the user interface and player experience of Heptic Arena across PC and console. You'll report to the Creative Director and set the UI vision, standards and direction for the game. You'll also stay hands-on: designing screens, building assets and working in engine day to day.

Lead, Manage, Define and maintain Heptic Arena's Players UX,UI visual language and design system (components, typography, iconography, colour, motion,accessibility guidelines.

Lead UI/UX across the full player journey: front end, HUD, menus, progression, store, social features and onboarding.

Propose, Concept, Design, prototype and deliver: wireframes, user flows, screen maps, mockups and final UI assets, from early concept through to polish.

Work closely with Game Design and Engineering on implementation in Unreal Engine, and resolve UX trade-offs and technical constraints early.

Use playtest feedback, analytics and A/B testing to find UX problems and iterate on solutions.

Mentor junior designers and freelancers through design reviews, feedback and clear briefs.

Estimate, plan and prioritise UX/UI work with Production, Execute and control development, create and distribute UX/UI tasks in Jira.

Own UX/UI documentation in Confluence and keep it the single source of truth for the team.

  • Self-driven and organized, able to thrive in a remote, self-managing team.
  • Based in or near the Central European time zone (CET ± 2 hours).

  • Experience with UI animation and motion design, such as After Effects, Rive or in-engine animation.
  • Experience with multiplayer, live-service or competitive shooter UI, including HUDs, scoreboards, matchmaking, stores and battle passes.
  • Knowledge of console platform UI guidelines.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards for games.
  • Experience running or analysing usability tests.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplined team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Product Designer – UX/UI, Design Systems & SaaS

Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end product design experience across web and mobile applications.

This is not a purely visual design role. We’re looking for someone who combines UX research, product thinking, UI design, prototyping, and design systems to solve real user problems and create intuitive, scalable digital products.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle — from understanding user needs and mapping workflows to designing polished interfaces, maintaining design systems, and supporting implementation.

If you think in user journeys, flows, systems, and outcomes — not just individual screens — this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

UX Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and product research.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify friction across the product experience.
  • Translate research into:
    • User flows
    • Journey maps
    • Personas
    • Wireframes
    • Interaction models
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to recommend product improvements.
  • Work with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar platforms to support design decisions.

UX/UI & Product Design

  • Own design from early concepts through production-ready interfaces.
  • Create:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • High-fidelity UI
  • Design intuitive experiences across web and mobile applications.
  • Simplify complex workflows into clear, user-friendly experiences.
  • Create responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Iterate quickly based on user feedback, product requirements, and analytics.

Figma & Design Systems

  • Work extensively in Figma to create and maintain production-ready designs.
  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Establish and document standards for:
    • Typography
    • Color
    • Spacing
    • Components
    • Interaction patterns
    • UI behavior
  • Maintain consistency across products, features, and platforms.
  • Improve collaboration and efficiency between Product, Design, and Engineering.

Accessibility & Usability

  • Design accessible experiences aligned with WCAG 2.1 principles.
  • Consider accessibility throughout the design process rather than as a final-stage requirement.
  • Ensure interfaces work effectively across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
  • Identify usability issues and continuously reduce friction across key workflows.

Testing, Analytics & Optimization

  • Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions.
  • Support A/B testing across:
    • Layouts
    • User flows
    • Features
    • Interaction patterns
  • Analyze user behavior and product feedback.
  • Use findings to improve:
    • Usability
    • Conversion
    • Engagement
    • Retention
    • Task completion
  • Continuously iterate on launched experiences rather than treating design as complete after handoff.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Product Managers
  • Engineers
  • Developers
  • Other product and business stakeholders

You will:

  • Translate product requirements into clear design solutions.
  • Participate in product discussions and feature planning.
  • Communicate design decisions and rationale clearly.
  • Prepare developer-ready designs, assets, and specifications.
  • Use Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools for handoff.
  • Review implementations and help resolve UX/UI inconsistencies before release.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional Product Design or UX/UI Design experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating real product design work.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma.
  • Experience designing responsive web and/or mobile applications.
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Interaction design
    • Information architecture
    • Responsive design
    • Usability testing
    • Accessibility
  • Experience collaborating directly with Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.

Portfolio Requirements

Your portfolio should demonstrate more than polished final screens.

We want to see evidence of:

  • The problem you were solving.
  • Your role in the project.
  • User or business requirements.
  • Research and discovery.
  • User flows and UX decisions.
  • Wireframes and prototypes.
  • Final UI execution.
  • Design system or component thinking.
  • How feedback, testing, or data influenced your decisions.
  • The outcome or impact of your work.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Experience designing SaaS products.
  • B2B or enterprise software design experience.
  • Consumer application experience.
  • Experience building or scaling mature design systems.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Hotjar
    • Product analytics platforms
  • Experience with experimentation and A/B testing.
  • Basic understanding of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Experience working in Agile or sprint-based product teams.
  • Familiarity with developer handoff through Figma Dev Mode or Zeplin.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Think about the entire user journey rather than isolated screens.
  • Can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions.
  • Balance user needs with product and business objectives.
  • Enjoy simplifying complicated workflows.
  • Use research, feedback, and data rather than designing entirely from intuition.
  • Think systematically about reusable components and patterns.
  • Care about accessibility and usability.
  • Collaborate effectively with engineers.
  • Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.
  • Can independently take a product problem from discovery through final design.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing product requirements with a Product Manager.
  • Analyzing user behavior or customer feedback.
  • Mapping a new user journey or workflow.
  • Creating wireframes for a new feature.
  • Building an interactive prototype in Figma.
  • Designing polished responsive interfaces.
  • Conducting or reviewing usability tests.
  • Updating components within the design system.
  • Working with engineers on implementation questions.
  • Reviewing a developed feature against the approved design.
  • Analyzing post-launch feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement.

In short: you turn user problems and product requirements into intuitive, scalable, accessible, and visually polished digital experiences.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved usability and task completion rates.
  • Increased product engagement and retention.
  • Reduced friction across critical user journeys.
  • Quality and consistency of UX/UI execution.
  • Design system adoption and consistency.
  • On-time delivery of design assets and prototypes.
  • Reduced design-related implementation rework.
  • Effective collaboration with Product and Engineering.
  • Positive user and stakeholder feedback.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • End-to-end ownership of meaningful product design work.
  • Direct influence on product experience and customer satisfaction.
  • Opportunity to work closely with Product and Engineering.
  • Ability to shape and scale the product’s design system.
  • Exposure to research, UX, UI, analytics, and experimentation.
  • Fully remote environment.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead Product Designer
    • Design Lead
    • Head of Design

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer.
  • The types of SaaS, web, or mobile products you’ve designed.
  • A product or feature you designed end-to-end and the problem you were solving.
  • How you approach UX research before beginning the visual design process.
  • Your experience building or maintaining design systems in Figma.
  • An example of a complex workflow you simplified for users.
  • How you collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers during development.
  • How user feedback, usability testing, or analytics influenced one of your design decisions.

Please keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We’re interested in understanding your product thinking, communication ability, UX process, and the reasoning behind your design decisions.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.
